# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Stabilized the new molt/mineral regressions so they isolate mineral effects deterministically and updated the shrimp reproduction budget fixture to seed explicit Ca/Mg support required by the molt model. The 1000-hour `hard_shrimp` vs `ro_like` survival comparison, failed-molt mortality regression, and broader closed-system budget coverage now pass against the existing stage-aware molt implementation in this branch.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Adjusted the long-horizon molt/mineral tests to freeze condition drift and feeding noise so the soft-vs-hard water and failed-molt mortality assertions measure mineral-driven behavior deterministically.
2. [Completed] Updated the shrimp reproduction budget fixture to include explicit calcium and magnesium support so the closed-system reproduction conservation test remains valid with mineral-gated molting.
3. [Completed] Ran targeted regressions plus full `tank_core`, `tank_data`, and `tank_scenarios` test suites to verify the fixes end to end.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core step_hours_rejects_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_before_simulation -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core malformed_current_save_with_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_is_rejected -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core inverted_stage_molt_intervals -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core test_closed_system_shrimp_reproduction_conserves_n_and_c -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core`
- `cargo test -p tank_data`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios`

## Outstanding Risks

None identified.
